name: 8374 — Governed Crossings (StegVerse)
description: Governance evaluation of a proposed machine transaction or action before it commits: admissibility against a declared policy and scope, returned as a signed, hash-chained receipt pair (ALLOW / NON-ALLOW). The fee is paid either way. Pricing is a variable total in USDC on Base: a governance fee (500 micro-USDC for the receipt-only tier, 15000 micro-USDC for full evaluation) plus a live settlement charge quoted in the fresh x402 challenge. The 500 micro-USDC figure is the governance component only, never an all-inclusive price; the challenge amount is the total authorized.
